name: M3_OIS100MI_GetOrderHead
description: Retrieve customer order header details without recalculating order totals. This operation returns information stored on the order header such as division, customer, order type, lowest and highest status, facility and warehouse, currency, payment and delivery terms, references, logistics settings, and user‑defined fields. Order total and tax amounts are not recalculated or returned here. For online calculated totals and taxes, combine this operation with GetOrderValue. The remaining‑amount fields show what still must be invoiced: one as total remaining amount, one as gross value before discounts, and one as net value after discounts, all excluding external charges and VAT.
